source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 21 September 1946, p. 3 ("Rural councils: nominations and withdrawals")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Votes and divisions from the Belfast News-Letter's classified rural council results (5 October 1946, p. 3), checked against the Belfast Telegraph's Antrim report (4 October 1946, p. 7).

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Four divisions were contested and Seacash was filled unopposed after W. J. Davison's withdrawal; the News-Letter's results report gives the votes for the four contests. Returned unopposed.
